===MANAGER===
param(
  [ValidateSet('START','STOP','STATUS','BUILD','VERIFY','BURST-ON','BURST-OFF','EXEC','RUNALL')]
  [string]$Action='STATUS',
  [ValidateSet('worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04','worker05','worker06','worker07','worker08')]
  [string]$Worker='worker01',
  [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
  [string[]]$Command
)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$LinuxRoot='/mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric'

function Invoke-Ubuntu([string]$Script) {
  $b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Script))
  & wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "Ubuntu command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
}

switch($Action){
  'BUILD' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose build" }
  'START' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose up -d worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04" }
  'STOP' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst stop" }
  'BURST-ON' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst up -d worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08" }
  'BURST-OFF' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst stop worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08" }
  'STATUS' {
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst ps && echo && docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.PIDs}}' heaven-worker-01 heaven-worker-02 heaven-worker-03 heaven-worker-04 2>/dev/null || true"
  }
  'VERIFY' {
    foreach($w in 'worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04'){
      Write-Host "===$w==="
      Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose exec -T $w sh -lc 'hostname; node -v; python3 --version; git --version; rg --version | head -1'"
    }
  }
  'EXEC' {
    if(-not $Command -or $Command.Count -eq 0){ throw 'EXEC requires a command after the worker name.' }
    $cmd=($Command -join ' ')
    $inner=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($cmd))
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst exec -T $Worker bash -lc 'echo $inner | base64 -d | bash'"
  }
  'RUNALL' {
    if(-not $Command -or $Command.Count -eq 0){ throw 'RUNALL requires a command.' }
    $cmd=($Command -join ' ')
    $inner=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($cmd))
    foreach($w in 'worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04'){
      Write-Host "===$w==="
      Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose exec -T $w bash -lc 'echo $inner | base64 -d | bash'"
    }
  }
}
